text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Grrrhhhh…………! I couldn't crown this with a 
glorious finish……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"To think you're still faster than me, 
Flower-san! It's so frustrating~!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You're right...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, there is no doubt that this is a 
great result!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"With these results, it might be a good 
time to wrap up the sprint training—"
choice_data_list:
Let's keep going until we win by 1000 
lengths!

Let us continue until we win by 1000 
lengths!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?
choice_data_list: Let's train your speed as much as we can!
Let's train your speed as much as we can!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That is what we should do, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Um, I have a question. Well, it just kind 
of popped into my head...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You aren't tricking me, are 
you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Didn't you just flinch!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, despite already being in my third 
year, there has been virtually zero 
training geared toward long distances.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I both understand and agree with Trainer's 
reasoning that it is "to reach the 
pinnacle of speed."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, lately, even I have started 
having some doubts...

Strengthening her speed right now will 
ultimately lead to her dream. I believe 
that is what's best for her. And yet...

If I can't convince her here and now, 
she'll end up throwing herself into a 
reckless challenge. In that case...!
choice_data_list:
Let's put together a Long distance race 
schedule!

Let's put together a Long distance race 
schedule!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oho!? And what might that mean?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come to aim for 
consecutive Tenno Sho victories across 
Spring and Autumn, and then take on the 
Arima Kinen...!!
choice_data_list: First up is the GⅢ Hakodate Sprint Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm!?
choice_data_list: Next up is the GIII CBC Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh?!
choice_data_list:
And for the finale, it's the GII Centaur 
Stakes!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No way!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't all of these races 1,200 meters?! 
That's not long-distance at all!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, you really were... deceiving 
me—
choice_data_list: No, this time I'm running in three races
No, this time I'm running in three races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...And what about it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hah! It can't be...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The longest race in the Twinkle Series, 
the exact same distance as the Stayers 
Stakes...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words... if you combine 1200m 
races, it becomes a Long-distance race, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I keep taking 1st place there... That 
means a total victory of 3,600 meters!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I can definitely run all the 
way through! I'm deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You really are a person worthy of trust! 
I'm so sorry for ever doubting you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will run those three races! I'll show 
you I can Bakushin even over long 
distances!

"...And so, we managed to settle on the 
Hakodate Sprint Stakes as the next target 
race!"
